## 2. Safeguarding

Kestrel safeguards relevant funds by segregation, in designated safeguarding accounts at Albion Clearing Bank (GBP) and Banco Meridional, S.A. (EUR). At 30 June 2026 Kestrel Pay Ltd held £1.02bn of customer funds: £0.94bn in GBP and €95m (about £0.08bn) in EUR. Kestrel Pay Europe Ltd held a further £0.22bn, so the group total was £1.24bn.

The FCA's new safeguarding rules came into force on 7 May 2026. They add a monthly safeguarding return and require the resolution pack to be kept up to date. Finance updated the safeguarding reconciliation procedure to version 3.1 from the same date.

Daily reconciliations. There were 61 UK business days in Q2. All 61 reconciliations were finished by the 11:00 deadline, and none showed a shortfall.

Q1 breach, now closed. On Thursday 12 March the EUR reconciliation was finished at 11:20, after the deadline, because the reconciliation tool could not load a bank statement file after the bank changed its file format. There was no shortfall. We reported the breach to the FCA on 13 March (SG-2026-01). Treasury Operations now checks at 15:00 every business day that each bank's statement file has arrived.

Monthly returns. The first monthly safeguarding return (May) was submitted on 12 June. The June return was submitted on 14 July, ahead of the deadline of 21 July.

Annual audit. Fernside & Co LLP, our safeguarding auditor since October 2025, completed the audit for 2025 on 27 March 2026. It gave a reasonable assurance opinion with two low-rated findings, both closed by 30 April. Interim fieldwork for the 2026 audit (KPC-2026-0326) has been brought forward to 7 to 25

September 2026.

## Part 4. Safeguarding of relevant funds

The firm safeguards relevant funds by segregation, in designated safeguarding accounts that the banks have acknowledged in writing: ACB-SG-01 at Albion Clearing Bank for GBP, and BM-SG-02 at Banco Meridional, S.A. for EUR, opened on 12 January 2026 for UK merchants' EUR balances. Funds received for customers reach a safeguarding account by the end of the business day after receipt.

At 30 June 2026 the firm held £1.02bn of customer funds: £0.94bn in GBP and €95m (about £0.08bn) in EUR.

Every UK business day, by 11:00, Treasury Operations compares the requirement (e-money outstanding plus Checkout settlements in transit) with the resource (cleared balances on the safeguarding accounts) for each currency, as at the 17:00 cut-off on the previous business day. Any shortfall is topped up from the firm's own funds by 12:00. Since March 2026 Treasury Operations also checks at 15:00 that each bank's statement file has arrived.

### 4.2 Safeguarding audit

Fernside & Co LLP completed the annual safeguarding audit for the year ended 31 December 2025 on 27 March 2026 with a reasonable assurance opinion and two low-rated findings, both closed by 30 April 2026. The FCA's new safeguarding rules applied from 7 May 2026; the firm has submitted a monthly safeguarding return since May 2026.
